about_the_game:
You are Florian Schulz, a former screenwriter turned film censor who once dreamt of producing an award-winning script before being brought down to earth by family’s financial struggles.

Despite no longer being a screenwriter, your connection with the film industry remains. As a film censor, your job is to strictly follow the provided guidelines and decide which films will be shown to the public - or never see the light of day. Failure to comply means losing a stable government job.

Every decision carries weight. For example, rejecting a filmmaker’s work could ruin their career, while approving a film with discriminatory content may incite racial tension.

You can choose to strictly adhere to the rules and remain completely loyal to the government. Alternatively, by earning your boss's trust, you’ll gain the opportunity to make censorship decisions according to your own will. The choice is yours.

How will you balance your duty to your country, your ambitions and the needs of your family?


Features

  • Experience the life of a film censor: Read manual, keep yourself informed of current events, perform film examination and decide whether to approve, cut or reject the film

  • Branching narrative with multiple endings

  • Discover how your decisions affect yourself, the people around you and beyond

  • Chat with people close to you and learn about their ambitions and struggles

  • Utilize your hard-earned money effectively to provide a better life for your family

  • A compelling story about the struggles of ordinary people, like you and me, to make their way in a changing world

content_descriptors.notes: "Not Suitable For Screening" is a text-based game about film censorship. It involves text descriptions and implications of the following topics: criminal acts, violence, sexuality, use of strong language, use of alcohol and drug, and relevant mature themes.
